facts.statement: The genus is known from a single specimen, IVPP V.11333, consisting of a partial skull and postcranial skeleton.
facts.quote: It is known from IVPP V.11333, a partial skull and postcranial skeleton.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen was collected in 1992 from the Albian Zhonggou Formation in Mazongshan, Gansu Province, China.
facts.quote: It was collected in 1992 at locality IVPP 9208–21, from the Albian Zhonggou Formation (Xinminpu Group), in Mazongshan, Gansu Province, China.

facts.statement: Lü Junchang first described the species in 1997 under the name Probactrosaurus mazongshanensis.
facts.quote: The specimen was first described and named by Lü Junchang in 1997 as the third species of Probactrosaurus, Probactrosaurus mazongshanensis.

facts.statement: The genus Gongpoquansaurus was formally erected in 2014 after studies showed it was less derived than Probactrosaurus.
facts.quote: In 2014, the species was formally redescribed, and the describers erected Gongpoquansaurus.

facts.statement: Gongpoquansaurus lived during the mid-Cretaceous, approximately between 129 and 114 million years ago in the Barremian and Aptian stages.
facts.quote: que vivió a mediados del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente entre 129 a 114 millones de años durante el Barremiense y el Aptiense

facts.statement: Fossil evidence places Gongpoquansaurus in the Albian stage, between 113.2 and 110.1 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Albian to Albian (113.2 to 110.1 million years ago)

facts.statement: Phylogenetic analysis indicates Gongpoquansaurus is more basal and further from Hadrosauridae than Probactrosaurus.
facts.quote: Phylogenetic analysis by You and colleagues in 2014 found it to be further from Hadrosauridae than Probactrosaurus

facts.statement: Gongpoquansaurus forms a clade of Eurasian hadrosauroids including Koshisaurus, Batyrosaurus, Ratchasimasaurus, and Proa valdearinnoensis.
facts.quote: In this study, Gongpoquansaurus formed a group of Eurasian hadrosauroids with Koshisaurus, Batyrosaurus, Ratchasimasaurus and Proa valdearinnoensis

facts.statement: The name Gongpoquansaurus was not formally published until 2014, leaving it a nomen nudum for several years prior.
facts.quote: No fue publicado formalmente hasta 2014, por lo que fue un nomen nudum por varios años.

facts.statement: The genus name refers to the Gongpoquan Basin, where the holotype locality is now part of the 2288 km² Subei Gongpoquan Dinosaur Geopark established in 2006.
facts.quote: The genus name refers to the Gongpoquan Basin, with the holotype locality itself now being encompassed within the 2288 km2 area Subei Gongpoquan Dinosaur Geopark of Gansu Province that was established in 2006.

rejected.statement: Gongpoquansaurus is an extinct genus of basal hadrosauroid dinosaur meaning "Gongpoquan reptile".
rejected.quote: Gongpoquansaurus (meaning "Gongpoquan reptile") is an extinct genus of basal hadrosauroid dinosaur
